name: Reticulatum
description: A Roman wall in opus reticulatum: square stones set on their points in a diagonal net, banded every few courses with thin red brick.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @match(y % 3 == 0, @var(--rb), none); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -58%; top: -58%; width: 216%; height: 216%; transform: rotate(45deg); background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); -webkit-mask: @var(--rh); mask: @var(--rh); opacity: @match(y % 3 == 0, 0, 1); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -58%; top: -58%; width: 216%; height: 216%; transform: rotate(45deg); background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); -webkit-mask: @var(--rc); mask: @var(--rc); opacity: @match(y % 3 == 0, 0, 1); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --rc: linear-gradient(#000, #000) 2.444% 50% / 31.162% 31.162% no-repeat, linear-gradient(#000, #000) 50% 2.444% / 31.162% 31.162% no-repeat, linear-gradient(#000, #000) 50% 97.556% / 31.162% 31.162% no-repeat, linear-gradient(#000, #000) 97.556% 50% / 31.162% 31.162% no-repeat; --rh: linear-gradient(#000, #000) 50% 50% / 31.162% 31.162% no-repeat; --rb: linear-gradient(var(--color4), var(--color4)) 2.83% 4.132% / 47% 27.4% no-repeat, linear-gradient(var(--color4), var(--color4)) 97.17% 4.132% / 47% 27.4% no-repeat, linear-gradient(var(--color5), var(--color5)) -44.34% 50% / 47% 27.4% no-repeat, linear-gradient(var(--color5), var(--color5)) 50% 50% / 47% 27.4% no-repeat, linear-gradient(var(--color5), var(--color5)) 144.34% 50% / 47% 27.4% no-repeat, linear-gradient(var(--color4), var(--color4)) 2.83% 95.868% / 47% 27.4% no-repeat, linear-gradient(var(--color4), var(--color4)) 97.17% 95.868% / 47% 27.4% no-repeat; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
